attributes.board_name: North Carolina Board of Nursing (NP approval jointly with the North Carolina Medical Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 of the 50 hours within the NP's national certification, approved by a national credentialing body or ACCME
rules.alternatives: An NP with current national certification by a national credentialing body is deemed in compliance with the 50-hour requirement (the controlled substance hour still applies). Completing the federal MATE Act training counts for the controlled substance requirement for that 2-year CE period.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE starts with the first renewal after initial approval to practice.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation of all CE for the previous 5 years and provide it to either Board on request.

topics.who: NPs who prescribe controlled substances: at least 1 CE hour within the preceding 12 months (prescribing practices, chronic pain, recognizing abuse/misuse, or non-opioid alternatives)

rules.notes: NPs are approved to practice by the Board of Nursing and the Medical Board jointly; the rule applies to NP approval, separately from the RN license.
